Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

city — a large town. Example: The city is bigger than the village.
village — a very small town. Example: My village is quiet.
quiet — with little noise. Example: The village is quieter.
noisy — with a lot of noise. Example: The city is noisier.
modern — new in style. Example: The city is more modern.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The city is ... than the village.
• It is quieter.
• It is more modern.
• The air is cleaner.
• Which do you prefer?
